segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Dana. I’ve got the quote in front of me for 42 seats on the team plan, plus the two-hour admin training block. Annual comes to $31,080, starting September 1.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. That matches the seat count. We may add three more in October, but I don’t want to hold up the September go-live for that.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Totally. We can start with 42, and if you add three later it just prorates through August 31 next year. No need to redo the main agreement.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good. On billing, can you do net 30 and put the PO number on the invoice? It’s PO-7749.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, net 30 is already on the order form, and I’ll include PO-7749 on the invoice request. First invoice would go out September 1 for the full annual amount.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: That works. For implementation, we need our managers trained before the 18th. Is September 12 still available?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. I have September 12 from 1 to 3 Eastern held for your admin training, and then your end-user launch email would go out the morning of September 16 if you’re ready.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that timeline is fine. Legal had one question on the renewal language. It says it renews for one year unless we give 30 days’ notice. Can we make that 60 days?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes, 60 days is within our standard terms. I’ll send the order form with that language reflected, along with the security exhibit you already reviewed.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Send it to me and Marcus for signature. If we can get it by noon, I think we can turn it today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: You’ll have it in about 20 minutes. It’ll show 42 seats, $31,080 annual, September 1 through August 31, net 30, PO-7749, and the September 12 training date.
